name: Financial Services (GLBA, SOX, DORA)
description: Financial services overlay for agents handling customer financial data, transaction records, or financial reporting information. Packages evidence for GLBA Safeguards Rule controls, SOX internal-control obligations, and DORA operational resilience requirements.

evidence_requirements: Access controls and multi-factor authentication enforced for systems handling customer financial information
Quarterly user access review with management sign-off for financially relevant systems
Identity and authentication controls documented in the ICT risk management program
Least-privilege entitlements and segregation-of-duties matrix maintained for finance-sensitive workflows
Provisioning and de-provisioning approvals tied to financial reporting responsibilities
Periodic scope and entitlement recertification recorded for audit review
Change management records demonstrate secure development and testing for systems processing financial data
Third-party and externally developed tool risk reviews completed before production use
Release approvals link provenance checks to control-owner accountability
Encryption protects customer financial information in transit and at rest, with compensating-control approval documented when needed
Data exposure scans cover outbound payloads, generated output, and ingested context for financial information
Cryptographic key management and transport security settings are reviewed as part of financial-system control testing
Tamper-evident audit logs capture every financially relevant agent action with enough detail for ICFR review
Audit-retention schedule preserves evidence for seven years in support of SOX recordkeeping obligations
Logging and monitoring controls detect unauthorized access to customer financial information
Behavioral monitoring and anomaly detection cover privileged access, transaction spikes, and exfiltration indicators
Incident response plan defines triage, escalation, remediation, and reporting workflows for security events affecting financial data
Major ICT incident assessment and regulator-reporting runbooks are maintained for financial-entity use cases
DE-01.framework_reference: GLBA 16 CFR 314.4(c)(8), 314.4(h); SOX §404; DORA Art.10, Art.17, Art.19

reporting_obligations.assessment_type: Combined financial-services control package: GLBA Safeguards oversight, SOX internal-control evidence, and DORA operational resilience / ICT incident reporting support.
reporting_obligations.reporting_entity: Board or equivalent governing body, audit committee and external auditor, plus applicable financial regulators or competent authorities.

human_oversight_mandates.description: No explicit AI-specific oversight mandate is imposed by this combined profile, but GLBA requires a qualified individual and board reporting, SOX requires management and audit committee oversight of internal controls, and DORA assigns accountability to the management body.

DE-01.regulatory_citation: GLBA 16 CFR 314.4(h); SOX §404; DORA Art.17, Art.19

notes: This overlay treats financial-services handling as a combined control package rather than a single-regulation attestation. GLBA Safeguards Rule drives customer-information security controls, SOX drives internal-control and record-retention rigor for financially relevant systems, and DORA adds ICT resilience and incident-management expectations for regulated financial entities.
